summary: R1.1 Device Trajectory backend + frontend fully tested. All 8 backend endpoint tests pass; all 15 frontend flows verified end-to-end. One seed-data gap fixed inline (v2_cases row for the seeded DFIR case was missing).

minor.issue: Seed script inserts 53 observations into v2_shadow_observations but never creates the parent case document in v2_cases. As a result GET /api/v2/cases returned [] and POST /api/v2/cases/{id}/observations returned 404 'case not found' on a fresh DB. Testing agent inserted the v2_cases row manually so all endpoints pass. Main agent should update seed to upsert the case doc.

action_items: Update /app/backend/v2/seed/__init__.py to also upsert a document into v2_cases (id=case_dfir_bumblebee_akira_2026, name/tags/status/created_at) so a clean DB seed produces a listable case and enables the /observations ingest path.
Optional: intermittent preview-URL 502s / 30-60s latency observed during load; backend was busy with claude-sonnet-4-5 LiteLLM completions from another workflow. Not caused by R1.1 code.
critical_code_review_comments: seed/__init__.py only writes observations; a parent case row is required by CaseCreate/CaseOut contract and by /observations 404 guard.
GET /api/v2/cases/{id}/mitre/coverage: technique→tactic map is hardcoded (26 entries). Any new detector tech will fall to 'unmapped'. Acceptable for R1.1 per docstring but flag for future refactor.
trajectory router: no _guard() for CASE_ENGINE, only TRAJECTORY_ENGINE. Consistent with intent (trajectory only reads observations) — OK.
updated_files: MongoDB v2_cases collection: inserted case_dfir_bumblebee_akira_2026 seed row (data fix)
seed_data_creation: Inserted v2_cases document {_id: case_dfir_bumblebee_akira_2026, name: DFIR · Bumblebee → AdaptixC2 → Akira (June 2026), status: open, event_count: 53} because seed script only writes observations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R1.1 endpoints proven: /api/v2/cases/{id}/trajectory/device returns 55 frames across 5 lanes; /api/v2/cases/{id}/mitre/coverage returns 39 events_with_mitre, 17+ techniques, 7 tactics for seeded DFIR case; /api/v2/cases lists case; /api/v2/cases/{id}/observations still ingests; /api/rc5/parse (uses {input:...} body, returns verdict_v2) still 200. All 12 required frontend testids render. Filter chips filter 55→39 on suspicious; case selector opens, glyph legend popover opens, provenance card appears on glyph hover, evidence panel with verdict+confidence badges opens on glyph click, keyboard '/' focuses trajectory-search, activity tab shows feed with 55 items, zoom presets clickable. If preview URL 502s, wait ~60s for backend LLM workload to drain then retry.
rca of the issue: GET /api/v2/cases returned [] and observations POST 404'd because /app/backend/v2/seed/__init__.py only calls persist() on observations and never inserts a parent doc into v2_cases (COLLECTIONS['cases']). Reproduce: drop v2_cases → run seed → hit /api/v2/cases → empty list. Fix: after clearing prior obs, upsert {_id: CASE_ID, name, tags, status:'open', created_at, created_by:'seed'} into v2_cases before iterating COMMANDS.
